messages:
marie_support: FYI getting multiple customer escalations from EU customers — hosted inference calls returning 502/504 and high tail latency since ~11:03 UTC. ticket #CS-4421. Logs show gateway timeouts and downstream TLS resets.

mike_netops: looking. any AS paths or provider alerts? :mag_right:

marie_support: I can paste one stack trace & sample request (sanitized):

```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"input":"..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
> read: connection reset by peer
```

alex_oncall: I see spike in retransmits and dup acks on eu-west2 egress at 11:02:20. Interface eth3 counters +packet_dup. Suspect provider microblackhole.

mike_netops: checking BGP: saw AS path flaps with transit-AS 64520 -> 64521 around that time, routes moved, ECMP rebalancing. ping/loss to provider next-hops 20-30% for 1-2 min.

jamal_sre: can we confirm that it's impacting only hosted inference (gateway) not dedicated/private? customers say Hosted API only.

sara_dev: confirmed — Dedicated pools in eu-west2 unaffected. Gateway logs show 502 due to backend TLS handshake errors with model backend: `tls: unexpected EOF` and high KVS miss. Looks like intermittent packet corruption.

mike_netops: opening carrier ticket now. carrier_incident_bot: Incident created with provider ticket 987654 — provider acked possible egress path hardware issue. ETA unknown.

nate_prodops: mitigation idea: temporarily fail traffic away from eu-west2 to eu-west1 for canary customers + adjust routing policy to prefer alt transit. Can we turn on region fallback for affected routes? :thinking:

alex_oncall: starting emergency rollout: update smart-routing policy to prefer region eu-west1 for tiered-hosted; enabling prefix-level fallback. Pushing canary now.

marie_support: deployed fallback at 11:15 UTC. Customer escalation update sent. Early signs: errors dropped ~70% for affected keys.

jamal_sre: still seeing a small number of 502s for large requests (>2k tokens). Could be MTU fragmentation causing TLS record loss — provider reported keepalive drops. Let's throttle max request size on gateway for eu-west2 as temporary.

sara_dev: added quota: `max_payload_size=1MB` and enabled reassemble but logs show fewer TLS resets. Support to confirm with customers.

marie_support: customer CS-4421 acknowledged mitigation, asked for post-mortem and RCA. Recording for incident channel.

mike_netops: carrier confirmed they had a misconfigured ECMP hash on their aggregation switch causing asymmetric fragmentation toward our next-hop — they'll apply fix. Follow-up ticket 987654 updated.

alex_oncall: marking this thread as resolved for immediate impact at 13:05 UTC — last_message_ts 1770007200. We'll schedule RCA and client-facing summary.

marie_support: thx all. Actions: (1) RCA with carrier, (2) add automated fallback for severe packet loss, (3) run e2e stress for large payloads across providers. I'll open follow-up docs.

carrier_incident_bot: Provider status: Mitigation scheduled. Expected closure in 4 hrs.
